📺 Something is out of its cage. The audience is delighted. You are not.

Dinner is fighting back.

📺 "Wrestle it" is off the table tonight — the crowd has seen it.

📺 Plating. The judges lean in — three aliens who have never tasted anything.

What you serve now defines you across the galaxy.

📺 "Serve with love" is off the table tonight — the crowd has seen it.
